zh.text: 在這樣的日子，你要注意跨資產類別信號相對於 CNBC 關於股票的空話在說什麼。例如，高收益利差在本周較早 $NVDA 的炒作日沒有變動。一切都是關於炒作

zh.text: 描述經歷精神分裂症式一周後的巨大星際反彈。主要事件：美國對 14 個夥伴提議 20-35% 關稅，核心 PCE 為 3.3% 高於預期 3.2%，納斯達克短暫進入 -20% 熊市，VIX 接近 35，隨後因 FCC 批准軌道數據中心及感恩節前空頭回補而回升至平盤。亞洲 AI 鏈強力反彈（首爾 +5%，SK Hynix +5.41%，上海 +4.2%，STAR 50 +15%）。NVDA 因報導中國公司透過 Megaspeed 在上海安裝 Blackwell 晶片（GB300 NVL72）違反出口禁令而受挫，加上 S&P AA 負面觀察及伺服器出貨暫停，可能迎來首次重大營收下修。記憶體市場轉為賣方市場，Kioxia 已分配 2027 年產能，$MU 兩日跌約 15%，TrendForce/Goldman 預見 2028 年價格下跌。德克薩斯州重啟數據中心許可，包括 SpaceX 項目。十一月納斯達克 100 至周三下跌 8%，VIX 升至 40。

en.text: Describes a massive interstellar rebound after a schizophrenic week. Key events: US proposes 20-35% tariffs on 14 partners and core PCE at 3.3% vs 3.2% expected, Nasdaq briefly hits -20% bear market with VIX near 35, then rebounds to flat on FCC orbital data centers approval and short covering before Thanksgiving. Asia AI chain rallies hard (Seoul +5%, SK Hynix +5.41%, Shanghai +4.2%, STAR 50 +15%). NVDA hit by reports of Chinese firms installing Blackwell chips (GB300 NVL72) in Shanghai via Megaspeed despite export bans, plus S&P AA watch and server shipment pauses, likely first major revenue revision. Memory market becomes seller's with Kioxia allocating 2027 capacity, $MU down ~15% in two sessions as TrendForce/Goldman see 2028 price drops. Texas data center permits resume including SpaceX project. November Nasdaq 100 down 8% until Wednesday, VIX to 40.
